items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Now, the next guy, see, a guy that called Dink Johnson.

ctx.x: And the black and tan band in Los Angeles.
Well, that was the first jazz band out on the coast out here, see. Well, I mean you did. Now, the next guy, see, a guy that called Dink Johnson.
Yeah, I knew him very well. He made records of him.
